model: V5 focused active rivalry multi-city (synthetic, not historical S2)
counterfactual: five objective-vs-defensive cases with relic bonus effects disabled

rules.upkeep_settlement: 24 modelled hourly debits per simulated day
rules.attrition: ceil(10% of stationed troop power on insolvent hour; power-as-units approximation, not per actual unit stack)
rules.colonies: max 4 per alliance in lab, cost grows by city number/distance; original 10 per player not reached
rules.bonuses: 7% Sphinx maintenance / 5% Treasury gold; Dolmen combat XP not modelled

critical_caveats: Only 2 allied cities per side initially, few added, not true 10-city/player late game.
All matches give first alliance first choice/actions; observed advantage is partly deterministic order bias.
No real Jactari combat; raids apply synthetic immediate casualties without siege or travel.
Early economic coefficients cause large attrition and must not be used for balance decisions.
Sphinx discounts tracked separately from unpaid debts (fix from initial implementation).
Seeds diversify initial gold/troops and raid efficiency, but strategies still highly constrained.
Cash is stored per city with simplified instant same-alliance internal redistribution, NOT true caravan transit.
Dolmen cannot be valued without XP-combat simulation; Treasury gold not separately isolated.
Unit stock is aggregated troop power and can lose fractions of imagined troop types; actual game attrition is ceil per stack.
Scenario dimensions 48x48 are targeted duel geometry and are not representative of occupancy-70 world presets.
